current_state.summary: The source package is preserved and locally compared. Useful distinctions are available as reviewable TEST data; no active subsystem or CANON state was changed.

locked_distinctions.statement: Main Mirror and the Workshop experimental clone are separate systems.
Main Mirror's primary discovery record is machine-native typed state; the human Discovery path is secondary and advisory.

The source says fourteen-perspective verification is default in main Mirror; current local Mirror instead exposes an eight-stance Seam Cell while fourteen human roles live in the Workshop Discovery Engine.
Grounded claims, evidence, uncertainty, scope, and lineage are the knowledge substance; learner-facing forms are replaceable representations that must not erase epistemic status.
External submissions may be candidate evidence but do not directly write canonical Academy knowledge.
Execution success does not by itself establish intended observable outcome success.
Continuity is a compact current understanding of roots, direction, distinctions, decisions, sources, and unresolved work; it is not equivalent to retaining all memory events.
/songcheck is an established resonance and drift diagnostic distinct from /soulcheck.
The experimental VM clone record uses Truth, Agency, Continuity, and Wisdom; those four roots are not the broader contained-core root set.

The Modular Verified Library is described as an active modular scanner, extractor, verifier, versioner, rollback keeper, and anti-monolith pressure; it is not the continuity brain, Academy, Mirror, or a second Workshop.

open_questions.summary: Determine the cause of the VM clone's reported two-day idle result.
Reconcile current Mirror's eight Seam Cell stances with the source claim that evolved R1-R14 verification is the default.
Recover the exact high-assurance source list behind R1-R14 without reconstructing it from memory.
Define the minimum deterministic continuity brain without duplicating Library, Workshop, Mirror, or Academy.
Define a traceable cross-system perspective-draft contract that preserves disagreement and authority boundaries.
Add external Academy authenticity, corroboration, contradiction, poisoning, and claim-level uncertainty gates.
Bind RepairBuddy code screenshots to exact source state, bounded edits, observable outcomes, visual verification, and rollback.
Expose future hardware layers to AI without hiding them from human inspection and explanation.
Separate observed product regression from unverified model, context, retrieval, routing, and interface causes.
The first grounded object fixture now has human-text and AI-structured skins; visual, interactive, and cross-representation evaluation proof remain absent.
